lines.before: The project's own filled "Rules every brief carries" block (rule:agent-team-adapter) adds the project's values and wins where it differs from the preloaded rules. Guards back the table: the builder's edit fence and the checker's clean-tree stop run as hooks in the role files, and the push guard also runs as a git pre-push hook (once `core.hooksPath` points at `.githooks`), so it holds for any AI tool that marks its shell. Role files stay user level (`~/.claude/agents/`): Claude Code skips the hooks of a project-level agent file until that folder is trusted, and never runs them in a `-p` session, so a copy in a project silently drops its guards.
lines.after: The project's own filled "Rules every brief carries" block (rule:agent-team-adapter) adds the project's values and wins where it differs from the preloaded rules. Guards back the table: the builder's edit fence and the checker's clean-tree stop run as hooks in the role files, and the push guard also runs as a git pre-push hook (once `core.hooksPath` points at `.githooks`), so it holds for any AI tool that marks its shell. Role files stay user level (`~/.claude/agents/`): Claude Code skips a project-level agent file's hooks until the folder is trusted, and always in `-p`, so a project copy silently drops its guards.
lines.why: shortened to fit the module cap; same meaning (project-level agent hooks are skipped until trusted and in -p)

lines.before: **Rigor = distinct questions, not agent count** (measured: ~130 refuters added nothing; one critic found the three biggest misses). **A refute panel informs; a reader adjudicates** - panels score wording, not truth; a finding a panel refuted but the code confirms is REAL. **Yield check:** findings recorded per role; a role silent across two sweeps is cut; a gap the critic keeps finding becomes a role. Every sweep and re-sweep is the owner's to approve (orchestrated: -> Agent-Team field 11).
